extracted.intended_audience: novelists, literary students, and writers of fiction
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for composing and evaluating novels that operate in the ‘fantastic’ or ‘prophetic’ modes — how to use myth, supernatural devices, tone, characterization, and realism to achieve the desired effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited set of fantasy devices
rubrics_metrics.description: “These devices need never grow stale; they will occur naturally to writers of a certain temperament, and be put to fresh use; but the fact that their number is strictly limited is of interest; and suggests that the beam of light can only be manipulated in certain ways.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that fantasy relies on a relatively small family of devices (parody, division of personality, adaptation, etc.); innovation comes from fresh combinations and uses rather than inventing wholly new basic devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merge magic and common sense with ambiguous language
rubrics_metrics.description: A true fantasist ... merges the kingdoms of magic and common sense by using words that apply to both, and the mixture he has created comes alive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use language and images that function plausibly in both the mundane and the supernatural registers so the fantasy feels organically integrated rather than tacked on.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definite, individual characterization to make fantasy grip
rubrics_metrics.description: His character, though slightly sketched, is individual, and this definiteness causes the book to grip.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even in fantasy, give characters distinct individuality and concrete traits — specificity of character anchors the reader and enhances emotional investment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Socratic method / series of small escalating shocks
rubrics_metrics.description: It proceeds with a growing tension, a series of little shocks. The method is Socratic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plot fantastic consequences incrementally (question → counter-question → escalation). Small, logical steps or ironic reversals build tension and reveal character.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beware the limits of the 'wish' trope
rubrics_metrics.description: Fantasies cannot [be new]...the old story of the wishing ring...He has only to be sure what he wants and he will get it...the wish for happiness is problematic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When using wishes or instant gratifications, explore the logical and psychological limits (ambiguity of desire, unforeseen consequences) rather than treating wishes as simple solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use mythology as a structural framework
rubrics_metrics.description: Max has borrowed or created a number of supernatural machines ... the mythology is most important ... the fantasist here adopts for his mythology some earlier work and uses it as a framework or quarry for his own purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Borrow, adapt, or invent a mythology to provide a scaffolding of symbols and expectations; a strong mythology can unify disparate episodes and give the work depth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vary supernatural machinery — avoid relying on a single device
rubrics_metrics.description: To have entrusted Zuleika to one of them would be inept; the fantasy would become heavy or thin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid over-reliance on one supernatural gimmick; introduce a variety of mythic elements or ‘machines’ to sustain interest and tonal balance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parody/adaptation: advantages and pitfalls
rubrics_metrics.description: Parody or adaptation have enormous advantages ... but Fielding’s Joseph Andrews is interesting to us as an example of a false start.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using an existing work as comic mythology can jump-start an ambitious writer, but beware of becoming trapped: the work may shift into an independent mode or fail if the parody's aims and the author's skills conflict.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parody/adaptation as a way in for writers weak at character-creation
rubrics_metrics.description: Parody or adaptation have enormous advantages to certain novelists ... particularly to those who...do not take easily to creating characters. An already existing book or literary tradition may inspire them ... and gain strength.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If character invention is a weakness, anchoring a story in pre-existing myth or narrative patterns can supply ready-made roles and structural support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mythology enables large, experimental projects
rubrics_metrics.description: That remarkable affair—perhaps the most interesting literary experiment of our day—could not have been achieved unless Joyce had had, as his guide and butt, the world of the Odyssey.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For vast structural experiments (episodic or encyclopedic novels), a deep mythic or intertextual frame can provide coherence across scale and technique.

rubrics_metrics.name: ‘Prophecy’ is a tone of voice, not literal foretelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Prophecy—in our sense of foretelling the future we have no concern...Prophecy—in our sense—is a tone of voice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultivate an ‘accent’ in narrative voice that evokes universality or singing insight; prophecy mode is stylistic and tonal rather than merely plot-based prophecy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prophetic fiction demands humility and suspension of humour (in reader)
rubrics_metrics.description: The prophetic aspect demands two qualities: humility and the suspension of the sense of humour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To receive prophetic fiction the reader must accept a solemn, reverent tone; as a writer aiming for prophetic effect, avoid inviting dismissive, ironic responses through incongruent levity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create characters that 'reach back' to universality
rubrics_metrics.description: The prophet...reaches back...they expand to embrace [the universal] and summon it to embrace them ... they extend, and that the part of him on which Dostoevsky focused did not lie on that wooden chest or even in dreamland but in a region where it could be joined by the rest of humanity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shape characters so they imply or participate in larger human conditions—individuals should suggest universal experience without becoming mere allegory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spasmodic/intermittent realism and attention to small things
rubrics_metrics.description: It is spasmodically realistic...Little things in the foreground seem to be all that the prophet cares about at moments—he sits down with them so quiet and busy like a child between two romps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternate grand, songlike passages with concentrated, concrete detail; careful, almost clinical attention to small, real elements makes the prophetic parts more convincing and vivid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prophetic voice produces a sensation of song and roughness of surface
rubrics_metrics.description: It gives us the sensation of a song or of sound...This intermittent realism...characterizes these novels and gives them what is always provocative in a work of art: roughness of surface.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for a lyrical, musical tone that may leave irregularities and ‘dents’ on the page; controlled roughness can make the later smoothness and cumulative effect more powerful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prophet may distort or 'smash' domestic realism to illumine
rubrics_metrics.description: Perhaps he will smash or distort, but perhaps he will illumine ... he manipulates a beam of light which occasionally touches the objects so sedulously dusted by the hand of common sense, and renders them more vivid than they can ever be in domesticity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be willing to break or distort realistic detail when necessary to reveal deeper truths; such distortions should be intermittent and purposeful, producing intensified perception rather than mere shock.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid overworked reflection — favor implication and song over didactic hammering
rubrics_metrics.description: A prophet does not reflect. And he does not hammer away...It is talk, talk, never song.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resist explicit philosophical exposition or repeated argument; let implications and tonal music convey the work's deeper claims rather than heavy-handed moralizing.
